partially_covered.missing: Organization details are still limited to address and GLN; no properties for contact info, registration numbers, or other common organization attributes.
Item information is restricted to net price and quantity; no item description, product code, or classification properties.

cq_coverage.details: All core CQs are structurally supported. Partial coverage persists for queries about detailed organization and item information. No new CQs are missing.

strengths: Rich use of restrictions and equivalence axioms
Comprehensive annotation of classes and properties
Proper role modeling with reification and disjointness
weaknesses: Section subclasses (HeaderSection, DetailSection, SummarySection) lack explicit owl:disjointUnionOf axiom
Organization and Item classes lack detailed attributes

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7: No explicit disjoint union for Section subclasses
reasoner_risks: No non-standard datatypes; reasoner compatibility is high

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Organization and Item classes with additional data properties (e.g., organization contact info, registration number, item description, product code) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full coverage for queries about detailed organization and item information.

improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved logical clarity and validator support.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add more general class axioms for AgentRoleAssignment to formalize multi-role scenarios and ensure completeness in role modeling.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enhanced expressivity and reasoning support for complex agent-role patterns.

summary: The ontology maintains its strong structural and logical foundation from the previous iteration, with comprehensive coverage of most CQs and robust constraint adherence. However, the previously identified gaps in organization and item detail properties remain unaddressed, and the lack of disjoint union axioms for Section subclasses persists. Validator and reasoner compatibility remain high, with only minor risks identified.
